cohort: 11,026 women: 8573 nulliparous and 2453 with a previous caesarean section (550 of whom had a successful VBAC)
finding: VBAC does not confer an increased risk of OASI after a first delivery by caesarean section when compared with nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery was a risk factor for sphincter injury.
birth_weight: Fetal macrosomia (>4 kg) was a risk factor for OASI
